description: Check Japanese qualified-invoice registration numbers (T-numbers, 適格請求書発行事業者登録番号, インボイス登録番号) against the National Tax Agency registry with JPVerify, check that a T-number belongs to the issuer name (and address) on an invoice and that the issuer was registered — not cancelled or expired — on the invoice date, and match an invoice to a supplier's expected T-number or corporate number from master data (AP / vendor checks). Use when a task involves verifying a T-number, confirming who issued a Japanese invoice and whether its registration covered the invoice date, or matching an invoice to supplier master data. Paid per call (API key credits or x402).

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent validate API outcomes instead of assuming success?
Did the agent preserve evidence for request/response behavior and error handling?
